{"name": "write_solution", "arguments": {"code": "def all_Bits_Set_In_The_Given_Range(n, l, r):
    """
    Check whether all bits in the range [l, r] (1-indexed from the
    least significant bit) of n are unset (0).

    Returns True if every bit from position l to position r is 0,
    otherwise False.
    """
    # Build a mask with 1s only in the range [l, r]
    mask = ((1 << (r - l + 1)) - 1) << (l - 1)
    # All bits in the range are unset iff n has no 1s where the mask has 1s
    return (n & mask) == 0
"}}

    Args:
        n: An integer.
